first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Person A in frame 0 of this clip is nearby on the left. A person with short dark hair, wearing a blue-gray rolled-sleeve top, tan-brown pants, and brown crossed shoulder straps; tracked by clothing and continuous movement, and the position may change with the camera view.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The other person who continuously interacts with Person A in this clip. A person with relatively short gray-brown hair, wearing a dark crew-neck short-sleeve top and dark long pants; does not have Person A's crossed shoulder straps and continuously interacts with Person A while holding a sword.

entities.name: Sword A
entities.identification: The sword held by Person A, identified by its holding relationship with Person A and continuous movement; a long curved blade and a metal guard near the hand are visible.

entities.name: Sword B
entities.identification: The sword held by Person B, identified by its holding relationship with Person B and continuous movement; its designation does not change based on being at the top or bottom of the image or on momentary reflections.

entities.name: Wooden Plank Floor
entities.identification: The continuous wooden-plank surface beneath the people's feet and between the two people, with seams extending into the distance; excludes the stairs above, the Pillar, and scattered metal objects.

entities.name: Metal Debris on the Ground
entities.identification: A collection of disc-shaped and irregular small metal objects scattered and piled on the Wooden Plank Floor; individual pieces are not numbered, and Sparks from Clashing Swords in the air are excluded.

entities.name: Pillar
entities.identification: A thick upright columnar structural component indoors, visible at the side and in the background; defined separately from the closely spaced rods of the Grating.

entities.name: Background Wall Rack
entities.identification: A background structure composed of large dark wall surfaces, frame edges, and elevated beams behind the people, excluding the separately defined Pillar, Grating, Background Stairs, and Box.

entities.name: Background Stairs
entities.identification: Stairs in the background composed of several horizontal steps rising level by level, located behind the people and excluding ordinary floorboard seams.

entities.name: Box
entities.identification: A collection of low rectangular box-shaped containers in the background, with square frames, metal edges, and open or tilted lid surfaces visible; only the areas visible in this clip are counted.

entities.name: Flames
entities.identification: Orange-yellow tongues of fire visible near the Pillar, wall rack, and background edges; excludes the white flashes and brief sparks that appear when the swords clash.

entities.name: Sparks from Clashing Swords
entities.identification: Bright specks and short streaks that briefly scatter near where the two swords meet, appearing and dissipating with the sword-clashing action; excludes stationary Metal Debris on the Ground and ambient Flames.
